thread:
incident-bot: [P1] spike detected: text-generation-eu-embeddings error-rate > 8% (5m window). pages: @alex @mira. auto-fallback engaged: embeddings-small-v2.

Alex Rivera: saw the page, on it. grabbing context. ETA 5–10.

Mira Chen: I'm finishing a deploy, can take secondary. Alex, do you want primary?

Alex Rivera: yep, I’ll take primary. Mira secondary. Jamal, FYI for coverage.

Jamal Patel: copying. I can flip to primary if you need to step out.

Alex Rivera: quick summary: EU embeddings nodes started returning 500s from the kv-cache layer. traffic increased due to a customer batch job hitting long sequences. autoscaler didn’t spin up because of transient metric gap. fallback to embeddings-small-v2 reduced error-rate but increased latency for some customers.

Sophia Nguyen: ops-bot shows elevated kernel OOMs on gpu-pool-eu-3 around 07:12UTC.

ops-bot: node gpu-pool-eu-3-2 reported OOM at 07:11:43UTC. Eviction events: 6. Recent kernel logs attached.

Alex Rivera: mitigation plan executed: 1) routed attempts to fallback model (already done) 2) kicked warmup scaling for eu-embeddings pool 3) KV cache flush on problem shard.

Mira Chen: runbook pointer: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/embeddings/eu-oom - follow section "eviction-blast" for safe cache flush.

Alex Rivera: command I ran:

```
# drain requests to node, flush shard 7
redwood infra node drain gpu-pool-eu-3-2
redwood kvcache flush --shard 7 --grace 30s
redwood infra node uncordon gpu-pool-eu-3-2
```

Alex Rivera: after that error-rate dropped to 0.9% in ~6m, latency stabilized at +40ms p95. no customer-facing errors reported in last 10m.

Mira Chen: noted a coverage gap: EU late-night shift had only single oncall. recommend adding secondary for 00:00–08:00 CET window until autoscaler fix. filing follow-up.

Jamal Patel: created interim ticket TKT-7783 to add a rotating backup oncall window and update runbook with explicit warmup hooks.

Alex Rivera: filing incident ticket INC-4521 with timeline & root-cause hypothesis (heavy long-seq batch + kv-cache eviction + autoscaler threshold). assigned to eng-runtime.

Sophia Nguyen: logging postmortem cadence: propose retro Thu 2026-03-20 10:00 UTC. prefer 60m.

Mira Chen: I can host the retro and put together the action item list.

Alex Rivera: handing off now — Mira, you are primary for next shift; Jamal secondary. I'll be reachable for 1h if anything pops but shifting focus to deploy.

Mira Chen: taking primary. quick handover notes:
- current state: embeddings-small-v2 is serving EU traffic as fallback
- ongoing tasks: watch error-rate >1% for 15m window, monitor OOMs on gpu-pool-eu-3
- runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/embeddings/eu-oom (see flush + warmup steps)
- dashboards: /dashboards/embeddings-eu (tokens/sec, error-rate, p95 latency)

Jamal Patel: added alert rule: if p95 latency > 600ms AND fallback model serving > 30% then page both primary and secondary.

Alex Rivera: post-handoff checklist I completed:
- created INC-4521 (link internal)
- documented commands run and logs in the incident ticket
- escalations: none to legal or sales required
- customer impact: limited - a small subset of heavy-batch customers saw increased latency; no data loss.

Mira Chen: logging follow-ups to file after retro:
- ACTION-1: adjust autoscaler threshold for sequence-length spikes (owner: eng-runtime)
- ACTION-2: add warmup hook for newly provisioned nodes (owner: infra)
- ACTION-3: update runbook with explicit fallback verification steps (owner: devex)
- ACTION-4: add weekend/overnight secondary rotation (owner: oncall-sched)

Jamal Patel: I'll own ACTION-4 and ACTION-2 coordination.

Sophia Nguyen: I'll schedule the retro (Thu 2026-03-20 10:00 UTC) and send calendar invite to eng-runtime, infra, devex, oncall.

Alex Rivera: thanks team. leaving handoff in Mira's hands.

Mira Chen: acknowledged. taking over primary. I’ll update the incident ticket with any changes. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: reminder: please add @incident-bot tags INC-4521 to any follow-up docs for automatic tracking.

Mira Chen: noted, done.

Jamal Patel: brief post-handoff note — observed a small uptick in retry traffic from one partner integration at 07:40UTC, likely caused by their batch job. contacted partner success to inform.

Alex Rivera: appreciate it. good handoff.

Mira Chen: closing the thread for now, will reopen if metrics move.
